# SHADER7 (https://shader7.com)

> SHADER7 is an independent technology brand and web applications suite founded, designed, and developed by **Nishikant Xalxo**. The platform provides high-performance, 100% free, privacy-first, client-side browser utilities and precision CNC engineering toolkits. All computational workloads execute directly in the user's browser sandbox with zero server uploads or external telemetry.

## Complete Web Applications Portfolio

| Application Name | Canonical URL | Category | Primary Function & Key Features |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Passport Photo Studio Pro** | `https://shader7.com/photopassportsizepro/` | Multimedia & Biometrics | Official biometric passport & visa photo creator for 150+ countries (US 2x2", UK 35x45mm, Schengen, India). Includes AI background removal, formal suit generator, and 4x6 printable grid generator. |
| **CNC Machinist Toolkit** | `https://shader7.com/cnc-machinist/` | Engineering & Machining | Shop floor CNC calculation engine: Milling Speeds & Feeds, Drill & Tap charts, PCD Bolt Circles, Circular Arc Interpolation (G02/G03), Chamfer & Radius macros, and Fanuc Custom Macro B routines. |
| **3D CAD Studio Web Modeler** | `https://shader7.com/cnc-machinist/3DCADWEB/` | 3D CAD & Design | In-browser 3D geometry modeler, stock bounding box simulation, mesh inspection, and STL/STEP export. |
| **Universal Triangle Solver** | `https://shader7.com/cnc-machinist/Triangle/` | Trigonometry & Math | Multi-case triangle trigonometry solver (SSS, SAS, ASA, AAS, SSA) with altitude, median, area, and interactive 2D geometry canvas. |
| **Photo Compressor Pro** | `https://shader7.com/photocompressor/` | Media Optimization | Client-side batch compression for JPG, PNG, and WebP images with custom target KB limits and dimension scaling. |
| **CV Banao ATS Resume Builder** | `https://shader7.com/cvbanao/` | Career & Business | Privacy-first ATS-friendly resume maker with 5 recruiter-approved templates and instant vector PDF download. |
| **Receipt Pro Invoice Generator** | `https://shader7.com/receiptpro/` | Finance & Business | Itemized sales receipt, commercial invoice, and tax breakdown generator with instant printable PDF output. |
| **Hourly to Salary Calculator** | `https://shader7.com/hourlysalarycalculator/` | Personal Finance | Wage conversion engine computing annual salary, gross/net pay, tax brackets, overtime, and 50/30/20 budget allocations. |
| **FairShare Expense Splitter** | `https://shader7.com/fairshare/` | Personal Finance | Group expense tracking and debt minimization matrix for roommates, trips, and shared dining checks. |
| **Ber of Chat P2P Messaging** | `https://shader7.com/berofchat/` | Communication | Serverless peer-to-peer encrypted text and file sharing over WebRTC data channels. |
| **Trading Mastery Platform** | `https://shader7.com/bcal/` | Finance & Trading | Position sizing, risk-to-reward calculator, and price action technical analysis reference. |

---

## Technical Architecture & Privacy Commitments
1. **100% Client-Side Computation:** Images, PDFs, cryptographic keys, and calculations never leave the client's device.
2. **Zero Forced Registration:** No paywalls, no recurring subscription fees, and no mandatory logins.
3. **Progressive Web App (PWA):** Installable across iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS with full offline caching.
